hook: Hang lights in the fog, leave gaps on purpose, and watch the enemy army hack itself apart.
loop: Leave chosen slots empty and set Astray and Flit units around them
Enemy attacks go Astray into their own side; units Drown
Gaps and Drownings turn into permanent stats, gold and board wipes

growth.line: From Tier 3, Foxfire grows each Wisp per empty slot beside it; Drownings add board-wide +1/+1s late.

feel.early: Thin bodies dodging hits with Flit
feel.mid: Pick a road: gaps, decoy lights or Drowning
feel.late: Old Will turns the whole enemy board on itself

stars.why: Flips a 2/12 wall into a 12/2 for Fingerpost to aim
Turns your empty slots into a permanent growth curve
Every enemy follows the light: the whole Astray stack's capstone

card_short.u01: Leads the enemy across Astray; from back row, your own
card_short.u02: Flit: dodges one hit into an empty slot
card_short.u03: Leads the enemy with most Attack Astray
card_short.u04: Enemy Astray attacks grow your Wisps next to gaps
card_short.u05: Gold each turn while you keep two empty slots
card_short.u06: Fills empty front slots with Marsh Lights at fight start
card_short.u07: Flit, and gives Flit to the Wisps beside it
card_short.u08: Each Wisp grows per empty slot next to it
card_short.u09: Swaps the Attack and Health of the unit across
card_short.u10: Leads enemies across your empty slots Astray
card_short.u11: Astray attacks deal double damage, on both sides
card_short.u12: Swoop; an enemy Drowning buffs your other Wisps once
card_short.u13: Drownings bury gold you collect next turn
card_short.u14: Flit units Flit once more and grow each Flit
card_short.u15: Leads one enemy Astray per enemy unit beyond three
card_short.u16: Flit, leaving a Marsh Light where it stood
card_short.u18: Fills every gap with lights copying your biggest Wisp
card_short.u19: Every Drowning gives all your Wisps +1/+1
card_short.x01: One-hit decoy: sends the attack Astray, then goes out

builds.name: The Lantern Line
builds.line: Flit units dodge beside gaps; Foxfire and Follette grow them

builds.name: False Fire
builds.line: Fill gaps with decoy lights at fight start; Moon copies your biggest

builds.name: The Drowning
builds.line: Stack Astray with Jack until enemies kill themselves; cash in Drownings

liked: Empty slots as a resource, chosen against the next board you can see
Enemy Cleave, Bristle and Shield become your weapons; Gaffer combos shine
worries: Watch: Old Will plus Jack, golden worse, could wipe a full board
Watch: Aarnivalkea has no per-fight cap; Drownings could stack many buffs
changed: Self-hit rules settled: Astray lands once, Flit dodges only enemy attacks
Foxfire now grows per adjacent gap, giving the gap build a real curve
Glim's growth now goes to Wisps next to gaps
verdict: Rated 7 fun, 8 distinct, settled; ranked third of three Wisps. For players who love tricks and Start of Combat puzzles.
